description: This file defines a data generator class for the KITTI dataset, including methods for loading images and annotations, and mapping class labels. It also includes class definitions and dataset-specific logic.

classes.name: KittiGenerator
classes.description: A data generator class for the KITTI dataset, providing methods to access images, annotations, and dataset properties.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the KITTI data generator, loading image paths and annotations from label files.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total number of images in the dataset.

methods.name: num_classes
methods.description: Returns the number of classes in the dataset.

methods.name: has_label
methods.description: Checks if a label is known in the dataset.

methods.name: has_name
methods.description: Checks if a class name is known in the dataset.

methods.name: name_to_label
methods.description: Converts a class name to its label index (not implemented).

methods.name: label_to_name
methods.description: Converts a label index to its class name.

methods.name: image_aspect_ratio
methods.description: Calculates the aspect ratio of an image given its index.

methods.name: image_path
methods.description: Returns the file path of an image given its index.

methods.name: load_image
methods.description: Loads an image as a BGR numpy array given its index.

methods.name: load_annotations
methods.description: Loads bounding box and label annotations for an image given its index.
